title: 002 水晶宫系统才是真面目！

content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    经过一番捣鼓之后，无言总算是弄明白了三者之间的区别了。
简单来说，就是那些能够通过学习来掌握的能力分为‘技能类’，而那些无法通过学习来掌握的能力，就分为‘天赋类’，至于‘血统类’那就更好理解了，只有使用者拥有该血统，才能够掌握血统所拥有的能力。
同时，要使用这些能力，还有一定的局限性，同种类型的能力，就算不是同一类别的，也无法同时掌握，例如，直死之魔眼与写轮眼，一个是‘天赋类’能力一个是‘血统类’能力，但是它们同属于瞳术，所以只能拥有其中一种。
而且，使用者无法同时拥有两种或两种以上的血统，‘血统类’的能力，使用者只能拥有一种，若是想要换其它的血统，则必须舍弃本身的血统！
不过幸好，血统可以倒卖过来给系统，从而得到原本血统一半的能力点，虽然那叫一个坑，但是总比什么都没有好不是…
之后，又是一阵捣鼓，关于这个系统的一些作用无言也算是了解的差不多了，毕竟能够兑换的可不仅仅是能力，还有装备、道具之类的，那一个个让无言又熟悉又感觉陌生的装备和道具整齐的排列在兑换列表之上，让无言看得是口水直流。
在系统的提示下，无言也知道了，想要这些物品和能力，必须用相应的点数来兑换，装备点用来兑换装备，道具点用来兑换道具，能力点用来兑换能力，召唤点用来兑换人物。
只要有这些兑换点数，无言就能把它们通通收进怀中，无论是什么，只要是系统里面有的，当然，经过这一段时间的研究，无言也明白了，系统里面只有你换不到的，没有你想不到的！
如果说在看完‘装备’、‘能力’、‘道具’的列表之后无言还能保持身为人类的心态的话，那么在看到‘召唤’列表的那一瞬间，无言就完全脱离了人类的范畴了。
只见无言双眼突出，放出比狼还绿上几分的光芒，脸色近乎呆泄，他死死的盯着眼前的召唤列表。
初音未来：召唤点5000
黑岩舒：召唤点10000
伊卡洛斯：召唤点100000
宁静自然的森林，显得是如此的朝气，不过很快的，此情此景，就再次被一阵突然响起的鬼哭狼嚎给破坏的一干二净了。
我们依稀能够看到，在森林深处的一块空地上，一个貌似野人的小伙子在那里又蹦又跳，嘴里不断发放着噪音，让见者见了，也会不由的叹一句：神经病！
无言一边大笑，一边流眼泪，身体不由自主的一阵狂扭，至于是在跳舞表喜悦，还是狂喜之下乱扭一通，就有待专家鉴定了。
无言现在可以万分确定了，这哪里是什么金手指系统，这简直就是水晶宫系统啊！
什么大杀四方，什么征服世界，那都是浮云！
吾辈的理想乡，就在眼前了有木有！…
无言恨不得将那块投影面板给戳爆，将里面妹子给‘解救’出来，可惜，他那0点的召唤点，只能让他脸红脖子粗的在上面乱点一通，得到的，不过是一个不断重复的‘使用者召唤点不足’的系统提示音而已。

“系统，我到底要怎么样才能拥有这些所谓的召唤点啊！…”欲哭无泪的听着那系统的提示音，无言觉得自己都快崩溃了，这种看得到‘吃’不到的感觉实在是太不爽了，这系统分明是在调戏咱啊…
“使用者可以通过完成系统发放的任务，来得到相应的兑换点，或者是通过将其它的物品倒卖给系统，来换取一定量的点数。”
“完成任务吗？那么系统，我现在有任务吗？”看着自己状态栏显示点数的那一串零，无言心中难受啊，不过转眼间他就恢复过来了，这就好像GAL一样，只有完成攻略任务，才能抱得美人归，这是爱的考验！
当然，这只是一个类人型生物内心的自我独白而已…
而随着无言的声音落下，系统的声音就再次风轻云淡的响了起来。
猎杀任务：生存演练！
任务一：在巨兽森林内，猎杀魔兽100头；
任务奖励：装备点2000、道具点2000、能力点1000、召唤点1000；
任务二：在巨兽森林内，击杀10级魔兽10头；
任务奖励：装备点5000、道具点5000、能力点3000、召唤点3000；

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s quick channel for copyright complaints. After some fiddling, Wuyan finally figured out the difference between the three.
To put it simply, those abilities that can be mastered through learning are divided into 'skills', and those abilities that cannot be mastered through learning are divided into 'talents'. As for the 'bloodline', it is easier to understand. Only the user who has the bloodline can master the abilities of the bloodline.
At the same time, there are certain limitations in using these abilities. The same type of abilities, even if they are not of the same category, cannot be mastered at the same time. For example, the Demonic Eye of Direct Death and the Sharingan, one is a 'talent' ability and the other is a 'bloodline' ability, but they both belong to the Eye Technique, so you can only have one of them.
Moreover, the user cannot have two or more bloodlines at the same time. The user can only have one kind of 'bloodline' ability. If he wants to change to another bloodline, he must give up his own bloodline!
Fortunately, the bloodline can be resold to the system, thereby obtaining half of the ability points of the original bloodline. Although that is a trap, it is better than nothing...
After that, there was another round of tinkering, and Wu Yan almost understood some of the functions of this system. After all, it was not just abilities that could be exchanged, but also equipment, props, and the like. The equipment and props that were both familiar and unfamiliar to Wu Yan were neatly arranged on the exchange list, making Wu Yan drool at the sight.
After being prompted by the system, Wu Yan also understood that if you want these items and abilities, you must use corresponding points to exchange them. Equipment points are used to exchange for equipment, prop points are used to exchange props, ability points are used to exchange abilities, and summoning points are used to exchange characters.
As long as he has these redemption points, Wu Yan can keep them all in his arms, no matter what they are, as long as they are in the system. Of course, after this period of research, Wu Yan also understands that there are only things in the system that you cannot exchange, and there is nothing you can't think of!
If Wu Yan could still maintain his mentality as a human after reading the list of 'equipment', 'ability', and 'props', then the moment he saw the list of 'summons', Wu Yan completely broke away from the category of human beings.
Wu Yan's eyes protruded, emitting a light that was greener than that of a wolf, and his face was almost blank. He stared at the summon list in front of him.
Hatsune Miku: Summoning Point 5000
Black Rock Shu: Summoning Points 10,000
Icarus: Summoning Points 100000
The peaceful and natural forest looked so vibrant, but soon, this scene was completely destroyed by a sudden burst of howling ghosts and wolves.
We can vaguely see that in an open space deep in the forest, a young man who looks like a savage is jumping and jumping around, making constant noises from his mouth. Anyone who sees it can't help but sigh: Psycho!
Wu Yan laughed and shed tears, and his body twisted wildly involuntarily. Whether he was dancing to show his joy or just twisting in ecstasy has yet to be determined by experts.
Wu Yan can now be absolutely sure that this is not a golden finger system, this is simply the Crystal Palace system!
All the talk about killing everyone and conquering the world is just a cloud!
Our ideal land is right before our eyes, isn’t it? …
Wu Yan wished he could explode the projection panel and 'rescue' the girl inside. Unfortunately, his 0-point summoning point only made him blush and tap randomly on it. All he got was a system prompt that kept repeating 'the user has insufficient summoning points'.
"System, how on earth am I going to have these so-called summoning points!..." Listening to the system prompts without tears, Wu Yan felt that he was about to collapse.Okay, this feeling of not being able to see but not eat is really unpleasant. This system is clearly teasing us...
"Users can obtain corresponding exchange points by completing tasks issued by the system, or by reselling other items to the system in exchange for a certain amount of points."
"Have you completed the mission? System, do I have a mission now?" Looking at the string of zeros displayed on his status bar, Wu Yan felt uncomfortable, but he recovered in the blink of an eye. It's like GAL. Only by completing the strategy mission can you embrace a beautiful woman. This is a test of love!
Of course, this is just the inner self-monologue of a humanoid creature...
And as the wordless voice fell, the system's voice sounded quietly again.
Hunting Mission: Survival Exercise!
Mission 1: Hunt 100 monsters in the giant beast forest;
Mission rewards: 2000 equipment points, 2000 prop points, 1000 ability points, 1000 summoning points;
Mission 2: Kill 10 level 10 monsters in the Giant Beast Forest;
Mission rewards: 5000 equipment points, 5000 prop points, 3000 ability points, 3000 summoning points;
